text: Many experts believe the future of artificial intelligence will lead to something called general AI, or AGI. Unlike current AI, which is designed for specific tasks, AGI would be able to learn and perform any intellectual job a human can. The potential benefits are enormous, such as solving complex problems in medicine, climate change, and education. However, there are also serious risks, including job displacement and ethical concerns about control. Predictions about when AGI might arrive vary widely. Some think it could happen within the next decade, while others believe it is still many decades away. Regardless, careful planning will be essential.
